data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word 'lesus' or 'lessus', meaning 'least' or 'small number'. In the Bible, Lester is not directly associated with any particular biblical figure. However, it may evoke the humble and compassionate spirit of Jesus, whose name shares similar roots. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Lester usually hope their child will grow to embody least, small number and live with faith, good character and purpose.
